name: Magical Lemon and Lime
source:
Two people. One birthday. One cake. One magical girl. Melia (Lia) and Maria (Mary) have had to share everything in life, even down to their magical girl persona. What happens when tragedy strikes, and their shared magical girl form is all that’s keeping one of them alive?

[From [url=https://ant-langman.itch.io/magical-lemon-and-lime]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两个人。一个生日。一个蛋糕。魔法少女之一。梅莉亚（莉亚）和玛丽亚（玛丽）不得不分享生活中的一切，甚至包括她们魔法少女的角色。当悲剧发生，而他们共同的魔法少女形态是他们中的一个人活下去的唯一手段时，会发生什么？

[来自[url=https://ant-langman.itch.io/magical-lemon-and-lime]itch.io[/url]]
